answer: In February 2026, Grab's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program allowing the repurchase of up to **$500 million** worth of its outstanding Class A Ordinary Shares. This new program is separate from (and in addition to) the prior $500 million program approved in February 2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.135; Grab, FY2025, p.49-50].
